title: Tyranny
description: At the start of your turn, draw a card and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
smart_description: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]N[/blue] cards and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [blue]N[/blue] cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold], where N equals the counter's current value.
notes: Counter-type power that stacks. Each application increases both the number of cards drawn per turn and the number of cards that must be exhausted.
